title: Independence of Algeria
summary: After a ceasefire took effect in March 1962 under the Evian Accords, voters in Algeria approved independence in a referendum on 1 July 1962. France recognised Algeria as independent on 3 July, and the Provisional Executive set 5 July as national independence day. War death estimates range from about 300,000 (FLN, 1962) to 1.5 million (later Algerian sources).

uncertainty.note: Referendum 1 July, French recognition 3 July, national independence day 5 July; the ceasefire took effect 19 March 1962.
